_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Benin covering Dahomey Kingdom, Atlantic slave trade, French colonialism, and democratic transition.

ethnic_groups.name: Fon
ethnic_groups.notes: Largest ethnic group; historically founded the Kingdom of Dahomey; concentrated in southern Benin; Vodun religious traditions

ethnic_groups.name: Adja
ethnic_groups.notes: Related to Fon; southwestern Benin and Togo border region; Tado migration origins

ethnic_groups.name: Yoruba
ethnic_groups.notes: Southeastern Benin (Kétou, Sakété, Porto-Novo); culturally linked to Nigerian Yoruba

ethnic_groups.name: Bariba
ethnic_groups.notes: Northern Benin; Wasangari warrior aristocracy; Kingdom of Nikki

ethnic_groups.name: Fulani/Peul
ethnic_groups.notes: Semi-nomadic pastoralists across northern Benin; cattle herders

ethnic_groups.name: Ottamari/Betammaribe
ethnic_groups.notes: Atakora region; builders of Tata Somba (fortified mud houses); UNESCO interest

ethnic_groups.name: Dendi
ethnic_groups.notes: Far north along the Niger River; Songhai-related

ethnic_groups.name: Goun
ethnic_groups.notes: Porto-Novo area; closely related to Fon

current_leader.name: Patrice Talon
current_leader.title: President
current_leader.notes: Business tycoon turned president; re-elected 2021; controversial opposition exclusion

former_leaders.name: Mathieu Kérékou
former_leaders.notes: Marxist-Leninist era then democratic return; renamed country Benin 1975

former_leaders.name: Nicéphore Soglo
former_leaders.notes: First democratically elected president after National Conference

former_leaders.name: Boni Yayi
former_leaders.notes: Two terms; economic growth; controversial constitutional amendment attempt

910.name: Prehistoric and Early Settlement
910.description: Neolithic settlement of the Bight of Benin hinterland; early agriculture and iron-smelting evidence.

sub_clusters.name: Neolithic Settlement and Agriculture
sub_clusters.description: Early farming communities in savanna and forest-savanna transition zones.

sub_clusters.name: Early Iron Age
sub_clusters.description: Iron-smelting in the Atakora region; technological diffusion from the Nok complex.

920.name: Early Kingdoms and Aja-Fon Polities
920.description: Rise of Aja-Fon kingdoms; Allada, Tado origins; early statecraft on the Abomey Plateau.

sub_clusters.name: Tado and Aja Migrations
sub_clusters.description: Mythical Tado origin; Aja peoples migrate across the Mono River; proto-state formation.

sub_clusters.name: Kingdom of Allada
sub_clusters.description: Allada becomes the dominant Aja polity; trade contacts with European coastal visitors.

930.name: Kingdom of Dahomey
930.description: Rise of Dahomey on the Abomey Plateau; Amazons; annual customs; integration into the Atlantic slave trade.

sub_clusters.name: Foundation of Dahomey
sub_clusters.description: Houegbadja founds Dahomey; conquest of Abomey Plateau; centralised monarchy.

sub_clusters.name: Dahomey and the Atlantic Slave Trade
sub_clusters.description: Ouidah slave port; annual raids; Dahomey becomes major slave-exporting state.

sub_clusters.name: Dahomey Amazons (Mino)
sub_clusters.description: Elite female warrior regiments (Mino/Agojie); military role in Dahomean campaigns.

sub_clusters.name: Vodun Religious Traditions
sub_clusters.description: Fon and Ewe vodun; sacred royal cults; influence on New World voodoo traditions.

930.name: Borgu and Bariba States
930.description: Northern Bariba kingdoms of Nikki, Kandi, Parakou; Wasangari warrior aristocracy.

sub_clusters.name: Kingdom of Nikki
sub_clusters.description: Wasangari dynasty of Nikki; Borgu federation; resistance to Sokoto and French expansion.

940.name: French Conquest and Colonial Dahomey
940.description: French military campaigns against Dahomey; colonial administration; forced labour; early nationalism.

sub_clusters.name: Franco-Dahomean Wars
sub_clusters.description: Béhanzin resists French invasion; battles of Cotonou and Abomey; French victory and exile of king.

sub_clusters.name: Colonial Dahomey (AOF)
sub_clusters.description: Part of French West Africa; palm oil economy; 'Latin Quarter of Africa' educated elite.

sub_clusters.name: Independence Movement
sub_clusters.description: Sourou-Migan Apithy, Hubert Maga; Loi-Cadre; march to sovereignty.

950.name: Postcolonial Dahomey and Marxist Period
950.description: Political instability; six coups; Kérékou's Marxist-Leninist People's Republic of Benin.

sub_clusters.name: Early Republic Instability
sub_clusters.description: Maga, Apithy, Ahomadégbé rotational presidency; multiple coups.

sub_clusters.name: Kérékou Marxist-Leninist Era
sub_clusters.description: Coup of 1972; renamed People's Republic of Benin 1975; single-party state; economic decline.

960.name: Democratic Renewal and Multiparty Era
960.description: National Conference model; Soglo presidency; democratic alternation; Talon era.

sub_clusters.name: National Conference of 1990
sub_clusters.description: Landmark sovereign national conference; peaceful transition from Marxism to democracy; model for Africa.

sub_clusters.name: Soglo Presidency
sub_clusters.description: Nicéphore Soglo elected; economic liberalisation; structural adjustment.

sub_clusters.name: Kérékou Democratic Return
sub_clusters.description: Kérékou wins democratic elections 1996, 2001; peaceful term limits respected.

sub_clusters.name: Patrice Talon Era
sub_clusters.description: Business tycoon as president; opposition exclusion controversies; economic reforms.

unassigned_events.note: Events not yet assigned to a thematic cluster
